sloka: एते मृगगणा भान्ति शीघ्रवेगा: प्रचोदिता: ।वायुप्रविद्धा शरदि मेघराजिरिवाम्बरे ॥ २.९३.१२॥
transliteration: ete mṛgagaṇā bhānti śīghravegā: pracoditā: ।vāyupraviddhā śaradi megharājirivāmbare ॥ 2.93.12॥

translations.english: Incited by the clamour of the army, these swiftrunning herds of deer expelled from their retreats resemble mass of clouds in the autumnal sky shattered by the wind.
